card.name: Inside proper names and drug names
card.fires_on: The closing piece of a rare multi-part name, such as a person, place, organization or drug name, after the first part has been written. It fires on the last piece (arth, id, ling, ac, ard) that completes the name.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: The final piece of an unusual drug name such as gepotidacin or GATTEX.

modes.label: Proper name endings
modes.description: The ending of a person, place or organization name in general web text.
